doc: Shared snip-markup contract (features/snip-markup/fixtures/make-contract.py). Sync produces `markup`; upload validates and stores it on the capture doc; dashboard CaptureView returns it; MCP prints `expect_ss` lines; BPS only checks presence. Coordinates are integers in the pixels of the uploaded original.png (presign width x height), not the native screen. Text is trimmed before validation; unknown keys (editor-only bx/by, colour, etc.) are dropped. A markup with no notes and all marks 0 is normalised to absent (not stored, has_markup=false). Switch off (SNIP_MARKUP != 'on'): upload drops `markup` silently (no 400), MCP prints nothing new, dashboard hides it. Note text is JSON-quoted in the /ss text.
